mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_source_authorization SET continuation_state=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND continuation_state IN ('WAITING','SKIPPED','CONFIRMED','AUTO_CONTINUED','BLOCKED_BUDGET','BLOCKED_PERMISSION','BLOCKED_SYSTEM')
mapper.select: SELECT s.tenant_id,s.candidate_id,b.user_id,b.id AS batch_id,c.version FROM ai_hr_source_authorization s JOIN ai_hr_candidate c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.id=s.candidate_id JOIN ai_hr_batch_item i ON i.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND i.candidate_id=s.candidate_id JOIN ai_hr_batch b ON b.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND b.id=i.batch_id WHERE s.continuation_state='WAITING' AND s.wait_until<=#{now} AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND c.expires_at>#{now} ORDER BY s.wait_until LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_source_authorization SET continuation_state=#{state} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND continuation_state='AUTO_CONTINUED'
mapper.select: SELECT candidate_id,user_id,expires_at FROM ai_hr_original_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_original_grant SET status='CONSUMED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT limits_json FROM ai_hr_batch_limits WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND batch_id=#{batch}
SELECT payload FROM ai_hr_context_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND position_id=#{position} AND context_version=#{version}

SELECT tenant_id,candidate_id,policy_id,purposes,identity_json,extraction_json,file_id,wait_until,continuation_state FROM ai_hr_source_authorization WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate}
SELECT id,tenant_id,result_id,rating,reason_json,actor_id,created_at FROM ai_hr_feedback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND result_id=#{result} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT tenant_id,run_id,sequence,status,result_id,failure_code,created_at FROM ai_hr_run_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{run} AND sequence>#{after} ORDER BY sequence
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_matching_run SET status='BLOCKED',failure_code='HR_RECOVERY_INFLIGHT_UNKNOWN' WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_PENDING') AND created_at<#{before}
UPDATE ai_hr_batch SET status='BLOCKED',version=version+1 WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','CANCEL_PENDING') AND created_at<#{before}

UPDATE ai_hr_batch_item i JOIN ai_hr_batch b ON b.id=i.batch_id AND b.tenant_id=i.tenant_id SET i.status='FAILED',i.stage='RECOVERY_UNKNOWN',i.error_code='HR_RECOVERY_INFLIGHT_UNKNOWN' WHERE b.status='BLOCKED' AND b.created_at<#{before} AND i.status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_PENDING')
UPDATE ai_hr_source_authorization SET continuation_state='AUTO_CONTINUED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND continuation_state='WAITING' AND wait_until<=#{now}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_source_authorization WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate}
